accounting.owner: Authenticated GitHub operator login designated in Davide's direct decision and repeated exactly in the joint approval receipt
accounting.active_clock_starts: first product-branch creation or first scoped repair/test mutation, whichever occurs first
accounting.active_clock_stops: only at FC01A_R_READY_FOR_TARGET_APPROVAL or BLOCKED; the clock is continuous after activation and has no pause state
accounting.cycle_count_rule: A cycle starts when one immutable candidate plus one causal hypothesis is tested; changing hypothesis, invariant, or product diff starts a new cycle.
accounting.candidate_revision_rule: Any product-tree change after the initial complete repair sweep consumes one candidate revision.
accounting.expiry_rule: Expiry, missing ledger, ambiguous accounting, or exceeded count is BLOCKED; approval does not extend the budget.

required_evidence_per_cycle: one finding/blocker ID and one invariant
one causal hypothesis and one changed variable
command, environment capabilities, dependency-lock and image digests
collected nodeids/count, pass/fail/error/skip counts, duration, exit, and retry count
artifact/log digests without secret or user content
abort_conditions: Authority, frozen source, predecessor head, seal, decision, or evidence checksum drifts.
A diff escapes exact review/test/path authority.
Any of the exact ten review findings cannot reach PASS within two cycles.

A repair requires Voice, M01 behavior, live database mutation, provider setting, credential rotation, paid infrastructure, or any frontend product-source repair beyond the exact review allowlist. A changed Vercel input closure follows the separate conditional target budget and is not itself repair authority.
A confirmed secret, personal record, cross-user access, or destructive action appears.
An M00 route, relation, routine, project, ACL, RLS, storage, advisor, role, or shared-secret disposition fails or cannot be proved.
Any M00-critical lane is failed, errored, skipped, not run, infrastructure-unknown, or has selector drift.
The same finding/invariant fails after two scoped cycles, or any budget/time/expiry limit is exceeded.
An exact-head candidate check cannot execute deterministically.
The prompt, model/provider policy, rubric, synthetic identity, or M00 one-repair ceiling changes.
A production action is needed before a separate target-specific approval.
A new P0, P1, or M00-scope P2 appears.

required_next_sequence: separate Davide target-specific Gateway/LangGraph deployment approval
ordered candidate deployment and identity/rollback/route refresh
fresh M00 proposal and acceptance budget with a fresh target-bound window
